grammar.title: Demonstrative Adjectives: Este, Ese, Aquel
grammar.explanation:
Spanish has three sets of demonstrative adjectives based on distance from the speaker:

• Este/esta/estos/estas (this/these) - close to the speaker
  Este vestido es bonito. - This dress is pretty.

• Ese/esa/esos/esas (that/those) - close to the listener
  Esa camisa es cara. - That shirt is expensive.

• Aquel/aquella/aquellos/aquellas (that/those over there) - far from both
  Aquellos zapatos son baratos. - Those shoes over there are cheap.

Demonstratives must agree in gender and number with the noun they modify.
